message: The other day, I was trying to pack a go-bag for the family, and you’d think I was asking my kids to do algebra homework! 🤦‍♀️ They were far more interested in debating which snacks should make the cut than the importance of having important documents ready. It reminded me that preparedness can be a group effort, even if it feels like herding cats sometimes. I ended up turning it into a fun game—who could pick the most essential items in under a minute? Sometimes, a little creativity can make a big task feel lighter. How do you get your kids involved in your family readiness plans?
